accessibility: Semantic figure/blockquote/figcaption for testimonials; absent state renders an empty section that CSS hides (display:none).
inputs: proof {testimonials[{quote, attribution, source_ref}], credentials[{label, detail?, source_ref}], counts[{value, label, source_ref}]} or None.
name: trust-proof-block
outputs: {html, state: present|absent, rendered counts, excluded_unsubstantiated}. Absent state renders an empty shell with no testimonial markup; items without source_ref are excluded and tallied.
